item.interstice.tide_indicator.desc: Measures atmospheric pressure and buoyant tide cycles. Sneak + Right-Click a wall to mount.
message.interstice.bucket_corroded: The alien toxin corroded the iron bucket!
advancements.interstice.root.title: Between Two Seas
advancements.interstice.root.description: Step into the twisted realm between two oceans
advancements.interstice.corrosive_lesson: Try to scoop alien toxin with an iron bucket and survive its corrosion
Find and mine Riftsilver Ore in the floating islands
advancements.interstice.smelt_riftsilver: Smelt a chemically inert Riftsilver Ingot
advancements.interstice.riftsilver_bucke: Forge a Riftsilver Bucket capable of holding alien toxins
Contain Light Toxin in an inverted Riftsilver Bucket
advancements.interstice.matter_annihilat: Trigger cataclysmic matter annihilation by colliding the two toxins
advancements.interstice.geochemist.title: Master Geochemist
advancements.interstice.geochemist.descr: Acquire all 4 contact rocks: Vitriolite, Pyrolith, Aerolite, and Phosphorite
advancements.interstice.rift_discovery.d: Enter the Interstice and learn to stabilize a rift
message.interstice.rift.impossible_catch: The line pulls upward. There is no fish on the other end…
message.interstice.rift.entered: The Interstice. Right-click the glowing echo under the shelter to return to your entrance.
message.interstice.rift.incomplete_frame: Build a 4×5 Rift Frame with an empty 2×3 interior. Corners are optional.
message.interstice.rift.unsafe_source: There is no safe return position at this entrance.
message.interstice.rift.missing_dimensio: The rift destination is unavailable. No transfer occurred.
message.interstice.rift.no_landing: The rift found no safe landing. No transfer occurred.
message.interstice.rift.broken_echo: The linked return echo was destroyed. No transfer occurred.
message.interstice.rift.unsafe_return: The return entrance is broken or has no safe landing. No transfer occurred.
message.interstice.rift.unlinked_echo: This echo has no linked entrance.
message.interstice.rift.cooldown: The rift is still settling. Wait a few seconds.
message.interstice.rift.transfer_failed: The rift did not open. Try again.
item.interstice.rift_lens.frame_hint: Right-click a frame to open the portal. Interior 2×3, outer frame 4×5.
item.interstice.rift_lens.anomaly_hint: Offhand: an unusual catch without a storm. Right-click a full cauldron on copper to call an anomaly.
message.interstice.rift.emerged: You are back in the Overworld. This echo is linked to the portal built in the Interstice.
item.interstice.wayfarer_key.desc: Hold use for 10 seconds without moving or taking damage. One emergency return per expedition.
item.interstice.wayfarer_key.prepare: Outside: sneak-use with an amethyst shard to prepare a new expedition.
item.interstice.wayfarer_key.bound: Bound to an owner and expedition. Giving it away does not change its binding.
message.interstice.key.prepared: New expedition prepared. The key is tuned for one emergency return.
message.interstice.key.prepare_first: Prepare an expedition: sneak-use outside with an amethyst shard.
message.interstice.key.need_shard: A new expedition requires one amethyst shard in your inventory.
message.interstice.key.bound: The key is tuned to the current expedition.
message.interstice.key.no_origin: This expedition has no recorded external entrance.
message.interstice.key.foreign: This key belongs to another player.
message.interstice.key.old: This key is tuned to an earlier expedition. Retune it outside.
message.interstice.key.spent: This expedition's emergency return is already spent. A new key will not restore it.
message.interstice.key.moved: Movement interrupted the return. You can try again.
message.interstice.key.hurt: Damage interrupted the return. You can try again.
message.interstice.key.released: Concentration interrupted. Keep holding the key until it finishes.
message.interstice.key.unsafe: There is no safe position at the external entrance. Your return remains unused.
message.interstice.key.failed: The transfer did not occur. Your return remains unused.
message.interstice.key.returned: Emergency return completed. This expedition's entitlement is spent.
advancements.interstice.watchpost_salvag: Salvage a tidal membrane from a ruined watchpost
tooltip.interstice.tide_heart.food: Food: 3 hunger bars. Leaves a sapling after eating.
tooltip.interstice.tide_heart.repeat: Another serving does not refresh the effect or remove its cost.
message.interstice.tide_heart.aftertaste: Your sight returns to normal. You are now weaker and more visible.
message.interstice.tide_heart.unripe: The fruit is not ripe yet.
message.interstice.clingweed.stolen: Clingweed retained: %s. Break the plant to recover it.
tooltip.interstice.clingweed.passage: Passable curtain: retains one item every 20 seconds.
tooltip.interstice.clingweed.recovery: Stolen items remain in the plant and drop on destruction.
tooltip.interstice.umbral_coal: Burns twice as long as ordinary coal.
tooltip.interstice.luminous_bud: Shear the top of an open tide plant to collect it.
tooltip.interstice.living_torch: Light 13. Haste I within 4 blocks and direct sight; toxins remain dangerous.
tooltip.interstice.native_root.toxic: Raw human food: Poison I8s, Weakness I12s.
tooltip.interstice.mineral_fertilizer: One growth stage. Requires native farmland and lower toxin.
tooltip.interstice.cultivator: Harvests one mature crop, spending one planting item to replant.
tooltip.interstice.native_crop: Native farmland and lower red toxin; sunlight is unnecessary.
tooltip.interstice.reservoir.full: Contains one bucket of lower toxin.
tooltip.interstice.reservoir.empty: Fill using a riftsilver lower-toxin bucket.
message.interstice.backpack.invalid: Cannot open: backpack contents need checking.
tooltip.interstice.backpack.open: Use to open. Sneak + use to wear; B opens the worn pack.
tooltip.interstice.backpack.mode.1: Collects only items already stored with matching components.
tooltip.interstice.backpack.mode.2: Collects ores, raw materials, metals and native crops; other items must match stored samples.
tooltip.interstice.backpack.fire: The backpack resists fire and protects its contents while intact.
menu.interstice.backpack.collect_hint: Cycle collection. One pack works: open, worn, held, offhand, then first in inventory.
menu.interstice.backpack.sort_hint: Merge identical stacks and sort the contents.
menu.interstice.backpack.stash_hint: Move supplies from the 27 inventory slots. Keeps the hotbar unchanged.
menu.interstice.backpack.refill_hint: Top up existing hotbar stacks from the pack. Leaves empty slots empty.
menu.interstice.retort.auto_hint: Choose a matching operation automatically from the retort inputs.
menu.interstice.retort.pin_hint: Run only this operation. Insert ingredients manually or using a hopper. Selection is locked during a batch.
menu.interstice.retort.fill_hint: Pin this operation and transfer only the missing ingredients for one batch from your inventory. Add fuel separately.
menu.interstice.retort.count_scope: Counts retort inputs and your main inventory. The fuel slot does not count as an ingredient.
menu.interstice.retort.saved_batch: Ingredients are already reserved. This batch and its result persist through restarts.
menu.interstice.retort.fuel_separate: Umbral coal provides 3200 heat ticks. Coal used for sorbent is a separate ingredient and belongs in an input slot.
menu.interstice.retort.feedback.7: The inputs already contain a full batch
menu.interstice.harness.title: Back Equipment
menu.interstice.harness.button_hint: Equip or remove a backpack in its own back slot.
tooltip.interstice.spore_pod_shell: Placed safely. Biopaste arms it; shears defuse a live pod.
tooltip.interstice.route_beacon: Rename before placing. Any player can bind an indicator with Shift + right-click. One phosphorite crystal signals for 10 loaded minutes; capacity 40 minutes. The stored point remains after signal exhaustion.
tooltip.interstice.ballast_belt: Hold in either hand: counteracts the tide for 240 active seconds. Repairs on an anvil with purified vitriolite lining (60 seconds per lining).
tooltip.interstice.protective_coating: Use on an equipped chestplate or one in your other hand. %s protections from our toxins; no ordinary damage immunity.
message.interstice.coating.target: An uncoated chestplate must be equipped or held in your other hand.
message.interstice.beacon.fuel: Beacon: %s seconds of light. Fuel: phosphorite crystals.
tooltip.interstice.field_anchor: World-owned passenger lift with 27 cargo slots and finite fuel. Shift + right-click the platform to load it; ordinary use boards it.
tooltip.interstice.lift_controller: Sneak-use an anchor to link. Use cycles up → stop → down → stop. Sneak still dismounts; sneak-use while standing outside sends the platform down.
tooltip.interstice.lift_linked: Linked controller; works within 64 blocks in the same dimension.
message.interstice.lift.linked: Controller linked to this field anchor.
message.interstice.lift.unavailable: Lift unavailable: check ownership, fuel, clearance and whether its anchor is loaded.
tooltip.interstice.tether_spool: Use on winch:32-block line. Hold the spool and sneak to descend on a taut rope, up to48blocks. Release sneak for a brief pause; find support. Sneak-use: detach.
message.interstice.winch.broken: Tether detached: obstruction or missing anchor.
tooltip.interstice.ballast_exhausted: Exhausted core: inactive until repaired; the expensive pressure membrane is retained.
message.interstice.ballast.exhausted: Ballast exhausted. The core is intact; repair it on an anvil with purified vitriolite lining.
tooltip.interstice.unstable_rift_initiat: Overworld: use on a full water cauldron directly above an upright lightning rod. No storm required.
One successful entry consumes one initiator. Failed entry costs nothing. Bring a Wayfarer Key; this does not build a permanent portal.
message.interstice.initiator.apparatus: Use on a full water cauldron above an upright lightning rod in the Overworld.
advancements.interstice.rift_preparation: Craft an Unstable Rift Initiator. Use it on a full water cauldron above an upright lightning rod in the Overworld. Bring a Wayfarer Key for an emergency return.
advancements.interstice.arrival_guidance: Watch for the tide warning. A solid roof, even wet, stops the lift. Find riftsilver and a ruin. Return through your echo; keep a Wayfarer Key for emergencies. Local materials unlock a permanent portal.
tooltip.interstice.marker.bind_hint: Shift + right-click a route beacon to store its shared named point.
tooltip.interstice.marker.permanent: The point is permanent; its signal is finite. An unloaded beacon is never force-loaded.
route.interstice.status.lost: beacon removed or replaced; saved point retained
tooltip.interstice.field_lift.overflow: %s unsupported cargo records remain saved with this platform; the save needs inspection.
message.interstice.winch.descending: Controlled descent. Rope remaining: %sblocks. Release sneak for a brief pause.
message.interstice.winch.descent_stopped: Descent stopped. Unsupported suspension is limited: find a landing or continue descending.
message.interstice.winch.rope_warning: 2blocks of rope remain: prepare to land! Protection ends with the rope.
message.interstice.winch.rope_end: Rope exhausted: line detached. Normal falling resumes.
tooltip.interstice.structure_surveyor: Use: survey within %s blocks, up to %s sites. Observation posts take priority. Sneak-use: saved point. Completed scans cost 1 charge; 60-second cooldown.
tooltip.interstice.survey_mark: Saved: %s, %s / %s / %s. The structure may have changed.
message.interstice.survey.realm_only: Structure surveys require the V5/V6 Interstice realm.
message.interstice.survey.busy: A survey is already running. Keep the same surveyor in hand.
message.interstice.survey.server_busy: Other surveys are running. Try again later.
message.interstice.survey.cooldown: The surveyor is recovering from a completed scan: up to 60 seconds.
message.interstice.survey.started: Surveying within %s blocks: up to%s sites. Actual authored structures will be checked.
message.interstice.survey.none: No verified structure found within the%sblock survey (%sFULL checks). The radius was not expanded.
message.interstice.survey.found: Closest verified among checked sites: %s, %s / %s / %s, direction %s. Checked%s sites. Loot was not opened.
message.interstice.survey.cancelled: Survey cancelled: hand, owner, dimension or time changed. No charge spent.
message.interstice.survey.no_mark: No saved point. Start a survey with ordinary use.
message.interstice.survey.other_dimensio: The saved point is in %s. The surveyor will not load it from another dimension.
message.interstice.survey.saved: Saved survey: %s, %s / %s / %s, direction %s. The structure may have changed; a fresh scan is needed to verify it.
tooltip.interstice.backpack.void_resista: ✦ Void-Proof (preserved on back if fallen into void).
tooltip.interstice.module.magnet.desc: Pulls nearby items within 4.5 blocks into the backpack.
tooltip.interstice.module.feeder.desc: Automatically consumes food from the backpack when hungry.
tooltip.interstice.module.feeder.mode.ec: Auto-feeder mode: Economy (threshold: <= 7 hunger). Click to toggle.
tooltip.interstice.module.feeder.mode.fa: Auto-feeder mode: Fast (threshold: any hunger drop). Click to toggle.
tooltip.interstice.module.feeder.toggle_: Right-click in hand or use backpack button to toggle mode.
tooltip.interstice.module.compression.de: Automatically compacts ingots, nuggets, and minerals 9-to-1.
menu.interstice.harness.open_pack_hint: Open the worn backpack contents (Hotkey B).
